text: In 1940 in Oklahoma City, a police detective bought copies of Vladimir Lenin's The State and Revolution at a bookstore. The purchase was made on July 24, 1940. On Aug. 17, police raided the store, arrested about 20 people including customers, and seized more than 10,000 books.
meta_description: The State and Revolution by Lenin: copies bought by a police detective in July 1940 led to a raid in which over ten thousand books were seized.
changes: Purchase and raid dated with the exact days; arrests added from the source.
